compliance.summary: The page’s central offer and terminology frame GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and Claude-focused provider, rather than the approved Data & AI Engineers recruiting service. The page also promotes a discontinued Benchmark offer and contains unsupported recruiting claims, client claims, and client figures that must not carry into a rewrite.
